authorizationTerms: Permit automatic physical-site UUID allocation for all future qualifying low-risk airports in this country/issuer scope, without per-airport approval. Require original replay, independent operator site/address evidence, complete edition and competition checks. No code/name validity, relocation, correction, test authority, or direct main writes. Candidate PR only; human merge required.

controlledAipAdapter.basis: Official MOLIT AIRAC package URL plus the index WEF clock. A source may not be relabelled as a different observation.

independentSourceProfiles.lineageReview: IIAC publishes its own airport/terminal addresses as asset operator. AIP pages are not counted as independent of MOLIT. No copied AIP coordinates relied upon.
KAC publishes its own Gimpo facility location and contact address. Only operator site/address corroboration is used, not inherited aeronautical data.

rules.independentLocationBasis: Named operator-owned facility address linked to AIP street and locality. No exact independent ARP claim.
